mechanisms: C19 Job/Run/Step/Action is the only coordinator state authority; durable target receipts model the external simulator
Atomic claim with expected revision and renewable 1-60000 ms lease; current job attempt, actor scope and epoch guard every worker mutation
Step reservations and action in-flight intent commit before fixed operations; local changes and their confirmation commit atomically
Five-stage preparation batch reuses M3.3 without nested jobs; review and approval remain distinct with exact source/artifact bindings
Fresh invalidation preserves history and valid step references while requiring current transcript reclassification and replacement review
Current grant actor/resource/destination/hash/time/revision is checked immediately before effect dispatch and local mutation
Stable logical action keys exclude run/worker attempts; retry preserves prior receipts and consumed budgets; terminal action data immutable
Unknown target outcomes never automatically resend; independent target verification and sealed no-effect proofs allow controlled reconciliation/retry
Cancellation fences workers, preserves observed effects and redacts inaccessible context; immutable job inputs may be cancelled without rereading revoked sources
Bounded started steps, run/effect attempts and fixed wall-clock deadline are enforced; unmetered numeric model budgets are rejected
Actual process exits recover hot/cold journals and reconcile a target commit without a coordinator receipt
limitations: Fixed local human workflow profiles; no model invocation, autonomous semantic extraction, runtime sandbox or hostile-owner confinement
Per-store SQLite fencing only; no cross-database migration/host fencing, scheduler or second runtime
Local preparation is one atomic batch, not suspendable within its inner operations
Only an explicitly identified simulator target; no real external delivery or integration
Token/cost limits must be null until a metered runtime exists; the job deadline includes human waiting
Current shared knowledge profile bounds and original foundation/catalog compatibility are retained
